lastChecked.mist: 2026-09-09 product update (latest found as of Oct 20)

changes.text: Aruba ESP (announced Jun 2020) brings AI Insights, AI Search and AI Assist to Central. AOS 10 and cloud AirMatch follow that fall.
Mist already ships RRM, SLEs, Marvis queries (GA 2018) and Marvis Actions (Nov 2019), Missing VLAN among them.
Marvis Conversational Interface launches as the next generation of the Marvis assistant.
Marvis Client for Android, available by request through support.

notches.title: New Central is announced, Marvis gets an LLM

changes.text: Next-gen Central announced at Atmosphere. It sits next to Classic behind a UI toggle.
Marvis starts answering documentation questions through an LLM, and Zoom call data arrives as a beta.
GenAI AI Search lands in Central, all tiers. Classic gets it in 2.5.8 along with AI power-save recommendations.
Zoom call root cause with Shapley feature ranking (Jan 25). Teams queries landed in Nov 2023.
Marvis Minis GA. APs run synthetic client tests on user VLANs every hour, no clients needed. Included with Marvis for Wireless.

notches.label: Mid 25
notches.title: LEM ships, HPE pitches an agentic mesh

changes.text: LEM experience correlation GA for orgs with Zoom or Teams integrated (Apr 14). Needs Marvis for Wireless.
Client-to-cloud Minis, a self-driving Marvis Actions dashboard and Marvis Client for Windows and macOS announced (May 7).
GreenLake Intelligence announced: an agentic mesh and a conversational networking copilot, promised for Q3 2025.
First self-driving actions GA: switch port stuck, AP non-compliant firmware, WAN edge non-compliant. Port Stuck self-drives by default; the other two are opt-in.
Marvis Client for iOS with certificate onboarding (needs Access Assurance). Minis add auth server probing.
HPE announces an agentic AI framework for Marvis.

notches.label: Late 25
notches.title: Copilot ships, the platforms start trading features

changes.text: HPE Networking Copilot appears in release notes: natural-language queries, chat history, NL to CLI for AOS-CX. Gated by tier and role.
Org Insights NOC dashboard in Beta (Sep 23). Intermittent WAN Connectivity self-drives by default (Nov 12).
HPE announces LEM for Central, agentic mesh and Central's NOC views for Mist, and dual-platform Wi-Fi 7 APs.
An HPE blog the same day says Marvis Actions and LEM are now in Central. No Central release note backs the Marvis part.
Application Experience Predictor (built on Mist LEM) in Select Availability. Client roaming events on floorplans. STP Anomaly Recommender gets a TCN action card.
Copilot Agentic-Mesh for 802.11r: detection, root cause, then a recommendation pill. Capability scales with license type and percentage.
ORCA troubleshooting for OSPF peer down and RADIUS alerts. Global Network Monitoring dashboard.

notches.label: Apr 26
notches.title: Copilot trial and the Advanced rule, Mist tunes RF on its own

changes.text: 90-day Copilot trial, then Advanced on every device. There is no separate Copilot license. Radio auto-recovery on by default.
Copilot Troubleshooting Agent turns alerts into root cause plus a recommended action.
Self-driving DFS Optimization, Dynamic Capacity Optimization and Rogue DHCP Server. Missing VLAN now triggers Minis tests.
HPE announces Dynamic Capacity Optimization, autonomous Missing VLAN, Rogue DHCP protection, real-time DFS and Client Roaming Optimization for Mist and Central. No dates per platform.
NAC policy dry run for Mist Access Assurance announced. It shipped June 2. This is the sandbox people attribute to Central.
AP 723H GA, the first AP that runs on either Central or Mist.

notches.label: Jun 26
notches.title: Agentic Marvis ships, Discover promises Marvis in Central

changes.text: Agentic AI in the Marvis Conversational Assistant GA. LEM correlation for every org, no Zoom or Teams needed. Wired Minis on EX (Junos 25.4R2+). Dry Run mode for Access Assurance policy rules.
Discover 2026: HPE lists Marvis self-driving for Central (wired port remediation) as available, and CX switches managed by Mist. No Central release note shows Marvis yet.
Global login across Mist clouds with an AIOps view for advanced-tier MSPs. Intra-AP roams counted in call-quality root cause.
Contextual Copilot queries from device pages and live connectivity insights (Jul 23).
Copilot prompt bookmarks (Aug 18).

notches.label: Sep 26
notches.title: Mist manages CX, HPE says the platforms stay separate

changes.text: AOS-CX 5420, 6300 and 6400 manageable in Mist (10.18.1002+). Self-driving Missing VLAN and Loop Detected, off by default.
Sept 16 release notes carry no AI items. None of the May autonomous actions have shipped in Central yet.
Press coverage of HPE's Sep 30 Investor Day: Mist and Central stay two platforms that share Marvis, APs and CX switching. Reported by two outlets; no HPE page carries the quote.

notches.label: Oct 26
notches.title: Copilot grows; autonomous actions still announced

changes.text: Copilot opens as a side panel, draws donut, bar and tunnel charts, and runs three queries at once with exact time ranges (Oct 15).
AP Health insight splits in two. Switch Offline root cause now flags a missing subscription. App Experience Predictor adds client detail, status unchanged.
Rogue DHCP alert gains thresholds, a summary and auto-close. The May autonomous actions are still not in release notes.

notches.label: Next
notches.title: Announced, not yet in release notes

changes.text: The five autonomous actions from May 2026, and Marvis wired port remediation from Discover. No release dates.
Agentic mesh under that name. Mist has its own Org Insights NOC dashboard in Beta since Sep 2025; Central's views have not shipped as such.
No end date published. Monitoring, reporting, troubleshooting and AI operations are leaving Classic for New Central. Onboarding, config and the Classic APIs stay.
